goal: Share external recall corpora outside checkouts and isolate derived indexes by schema
asset: Derived recall index and session context
scope: External note corpus cache reuse across project roots
Schema-separated local and shared index slots
Fused repository and corpus retrieval, freshness and writer metadata
outOfScope: Serving Codex passages outside their declared project scope

record.question: How can roots share corpus indexes without exposing note text inside worktrees or overwriting another reader schema?

options.strongest_objection: Requires separate freshness and rank fusion for two cache slots
Copies private corpus content into each checkout and plugin versions overwrite incompatible schemas

record.rationale: Store repo data in a small schema-specific local index and external corpus content in a shared user cache. Fuse rankings at read time; include scoped corpus policy in slot identity.
evidence: Open issue reproductions #147-152 #159 #161 #163 and current source inspection

costs.cost: One shared cache builder and read-time fusion
evidence: Existing graph/lex/vector caches and rank fusion can be reused

costs.cost: Repeated builds and stale incompatible corpus copies
evidence: Issue #162 reports three ~7.5MB indexes for one source

requirements.statement: Identical external corpora share a schema-specific user cache while repository indexes persist no note text; changed schema slots coexist, retrieval includes both stores and stats identify writer and slot
requirements.counterexample: Two checkouts rebuild one corpus twice, note bodies appear inside a worktree, or an incompatible schema overwrites the existing reader cache

checks.scope: Real source corpora and derived files across separate roots exercise reuse, fusion, freshness and schema isolation
assumptions: Cache directories follow host user filesystem permissions; source corpus metadata remains authoritative

challenges.claim: Does a detached rebuild or configured corpus authorize document embeddings?
challenges.resolution: No. Refresh and ordinary queries rebuild keyless; explicit build --embed is required for document backfill, and external notes require explicit FPL_EMBEDDER selection.
